title: A BROKEN KEY TODAY DOES NOT AUTOMATICALLY REWRITE YESTERDAY
semantic_thesis: Trust is historical. Discovering that a witness can lie now does not by itself prove that every old statement was false; neither does an old reputation entitle that witness to remain trusted forever. Janus therefore preserves both the old attestation and the later wound in the chain.

ru: Сломанный сегодня ключ не переписывает вчера автоматически.
Но вчерашнее доверие не даёт ключу права подписывать завтра после того, как его захватили.
Если неизвестно, когда именно доверие было потеряно, Янус хранит не придуманную точку, а область сомнения.
Восстановление не стирает момент ранения; оно делает его частью истории нового корня.
en: A broken key today does not automatically rewrite yesterday.
Yesterday's trust does not authorize a key to sign tomorrow after compromise.
When the exact loss of trust is unknown, Janus preserves an interval of doubt rather than inventing a precise boundary.
Recovery does not erase the wound; it makes the wound part of the lineage of the new root.

forbidden_overclaims: later compromise proves every prior signature fraudulent
recovery can always restore authentic continuity after total trust collapse
